items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: he invited me to be a part of Brass Fantasy, and so I got to be the bass player in that group of all brass players.

ctx.x: Oh yeah sure. Well he, again, because he had heard me play with Arthur Blythe and so he invited me to be a part of Brass Fantasy, and so I got to be the bass player in that group of all brass players. Again, homage and tribute to New Orleans while again taking the music and trying to go to the next mile while using traditional instrumentation, you just are paying homage to the tradition and not necessarily being traditional. You know? And he took it to a whole bunch of other different places.
When I was listening to — the one I have is called “Avante Pop.”
